body: REFERENCE-SCOPE SUCCESSOR 26df8dc BLOCKED in the formal candidate register. Baseline exact exported court passes 75 assertions and the parser contains all three repaired tokens. But deleting only implicit still passes 75/75, and deleting only infix still passes 75/75; deleting transparent fails as expected. The successor added a transparent surviving-consumer court but no implicit or infix court, so two prior reachable false negatives remain unprotected by the regression suite. Required recut: direct lawful implicit and infix fixtures with surviving consumers, and separate token-removal mutants that die. No other finding.
